The '''Derricon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derricon]].
